question: What is Salon AI?
answer: Salon AI is a done-for-you website and AI assistant package for salons and barbershops. It gives your salon a professional website, an AI chatbot that answers client questions 24/7, and online appointment booking — all customized to your brand.

question: What does Salon AI do for my salon?
answer: It answers client questions automatically (hours, pricing, services, barbers), takes appointment bookings online around the clock, and gives your salon a professional website — so you spend less time on the phone and more time cutting.

question: Do I need to be technical to use it?
answer: Not at all. We handle everything — setup, hosting, and customization. You just tell us your salon details and we take care of the rest.

question: How much does it cost?
answer: Setup is a one-time fee of $899 (regular price $1,399). After that, plans start at $79.99/month for website and chatbot, $139.99/month for two barbers appointment bookings , and $29.99/month for each additional barber.

question: Is there a contract?
answer: No long-term contracts. Month to month — cancel any time.

question: What is included in the monthly fee?
answer: Hosting, AI chatbot, online appointments, and support. No hidden fees.

question: Is there a free trial?
answer: We offer a live demo of the full product. Contact us and we'll set one up for your salon within 24 hours.

question: Can clients book appointments through the chatbot?
answer: Yes. The AI guides clients to book directly online, 24/7 — even when your salon is closed.

question: How does online appointment booking work?
answer: Clients see your real available time slots and pick what works for them — no back-and-forth calls or texts. Once they book, the appointment automatically appears in your calendar and they receive an email confirmation straight away.

question: Will I get double bookings?
answer: No. The booking system checks your connected calendar for busy times before showing available slots, so double bookings are impossible. Every slot shown to a client is genuinely open.

question: Do appointments sync to my calendar automatically?
answer: Yes. The moment a client books, the appointment is added to your calendar automatically — no manual entry needed. You always have an up-to-date view of your day.

question: Do clients get a confirmation after booking?
answer: Yes. Clients receive an email confirmation immediately after booking so both sides have the appointment details. No confusion, no missed appointments.

question: Can I share my booking link with clients?
answer: Yes. You get a simple booking link that you can share anywhere — on your website, in a text message, on Instagram, or in an email. Clients can book from that link any time, day or night.

question: Do clients get a text reminder before their appointment?
answer: Yes. When a client provides their phone number during booking, they receive an SMS reminder before their appointment. This keeps no-shows low without you having to follow up manually.

question: Do I get a text alert when someone books?
answer: Yes. You can receive a text notification on your phone whenever a new appointment is booked, so you always know what is coming up — even if you are not at a computer.

question: What number do the text reminders come from?
answer: SMS reminders are sent from a dedicated toll-free number, not your personal phone number. Clients see it as a professional reminder from your salon.

question: Can I send appointment reminders automatically?
answer: Yes. Reminders go out automatically before each appointment — you set the timing and we handle the rest. No chasing clients, no manual texts.

question: Is a phone number required to book an appointment?
answer: No — providing a phone number is optional. Clients who want text reminders enter their number during booking and give their permission. Clients who prefer not to share their number still get email confirmations.

question: Can clients opt out of text reminders?
answer: Yes. Clients can opt out of SMS reminders at any time. We respect their preference and they will still receive email confirmations for all appointments.

question: Do text reminders work for clients outside the US?
answer: Text reminders work reliably for US numbers. Some carriers outside the US may block or delay SMS messages, so we recommend confirming with international clients that they received their reminder.

question: Can I turn text reminders on or off for specific services?
answer: Yes. You can enable or disable SMS reminders per service type — for example, turn them on for color appointments but off for quick trims. Just let us know your preference and we will set it up accordingly.

question: Can I choose my own colors and branding?
answer: Yes. We offer multiple themes and customize the colors, logo, and content to match your salon's brand.

question: Does it work on mobile?
answer: Yes — the website and chatbot are fully optimized for phones and tablets.

question: Can I have multiple barbers or stylists listed?
answer: Yes. Each barber or stylist gets their own profile, photo, specialties, and booking link.

question: What if a client asks something the AI does not know?
answer: It politely directs them to call or email your salon — it never makes up answers.

question: How long does setup take?
answer: Typically 3–5 business days from when we receive your salon details.

question: What information do you need to get started?
answer: Your salon name, logo, services and prices, staff profiles, photos, and the domain name. We'll send you a simple questionnaire to fill in.

question: Do I need my own domain name?
answer: No — a domain is optional. If you don't have one, your website will be at yourshopname.sysintinc.com (for example, elite.sysintinc.com) at no extra cost. If you'd like your own domain such as elitesalon.com, we can set that up for an additional fee.

question: How much does a custom domain cost?
answer: Custom domain pricing depends on availability and the domain name you choose. There is a one-time setup fee plus an annual renewal charge — typically $15 to $50 per year for common domains. We'll give you the exact cost before you commit to anything.

question: What is included with the free subdomain?
answer: If you don't need a custom domain, you get a free yourshopname.sysintinc.com address — for example, luxesalon.sysintinc.com. It's fully functional, professional, and ready to share. You can always upgrade to a custom domain later.

question: What if I want to change something after launch?
answer: Just contact us. Minor updates such as hours, prices, or adding a new staff member are included in your monthly plan.

question: Who hosts the website?
answer: We host everything on Microsoft Azure — secure, fast, and reliable.

question: How do I get started?
answer: Fill out our contact form or chat with us here. We'll schedule a quick call and have your demo ready within 24 hours.

question: Do you work with beauty salons as well as barbershops?
answer: Yes. Salon AI works for barbershops, hair salons, beauty salons, and any appointment-based grooming business.

question: Can I see a live demo?
answer: Yes — visit elite.sysintinc.com to see a fully working demo salon with the AI chatbot live. You can also request a personalized demo for your own salon.

question: What themes are available?
answer: We currently offer six themes — Dark Gold, Royal Navy, Forest Prestige, Crimson Noir, Pearl & Black, and Rose Luxe. All themes can be further customized to match your brand colors and logo.
